entries.description: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term
entries.subject: Allah
entries.object: forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term

spans.text: [4] AR: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ EN: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term.

entries.description: He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver
entries.subject: He

spans.text: Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

entries.task_id: he|will|send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
entries.description: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
entries.subject: He
entries.object: send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

spans.text: [11] AR: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا EN: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
[18] AR: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا EN: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

entries.task_id: what|is|[the matter] with you that you do not attribute to allah [due] grandeur
entries.description: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
entries.subject: What
entries.object: [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

spans.text: [13] AR: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا EN: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

entries.description: While He has created you in stages?
entries.subject: While He

spans.text: [14] AR: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا EN: While He has created you in stages?

entries.task_id: how allah|has|created seven heavens in layers
entries.description: how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
entries.subject: how Allah

spans.text: [15] AR: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا EN: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

entries.task_id: and allah|has|caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
entries.description: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
entries.subject: And Allah
entries.object: caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

spans.text: [17] AR: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا EN: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
[19] AR: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا EN: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

entries.task_id: and children|will|not increase him except in loss
entries.description: and children will not increase him except in loss
entries.subject: and children
entries.object: not increase him except in loss

spans.text: [21] AR: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا EN: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

spans.text: [27] AR: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا EN: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
